description_en: Modifies the VPC private network access whitelist of an Elasticsearch instance
description_zh: 修改ES实例的VPC私网访问白名单
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch update-white-ips --instance-id es-cn-npk2154oi000b0000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --modify-mode Cover --es-ip-whitelist 10.61.xx.xx --white-ip-group '{"groupName":"test_group","whiteIpType":"PRIVATE_ES","ips":["10.2.xx.xx"]}' --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateWhiteIps

parameters.help_en: A unique token generated by the client to guarantee the idempotency of the request. The maximum length is 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The modification mode. Valid values:

- Cover (default): overwrites the IP addresses in the original whitelist with the values specified in the ips parameter.

- Append: adds the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter to the original whitelist.

- Delete: removes the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter from the original whitelist. At least one IP address must be retained
parameters.help_zh:
修改方式，可选值：

- Cover（默认）：使用ips参数的值覆盖原白名单的IP地址。

- Append：在原白名单的IP地址中增加ips参数中输入的IP地址。

- Delete：在原白名单的IP地址中删除ips参数中输入的IP地址，至少需要保留一个IP地址
parameters.name: modify_mode

parameters.help_en: The IP address information in the whitelist
parameters.name: es_ip_whitelist

fields.help_en: The name of the whitelist group. This parameter is required if the whiteIpGroup parameter is specified
fields.help_zh: 白名单组的组名。如果选填了whiteIpGroup参数，则该参数必填
fields.name: group_name

fields.help_en: The list of IP addresses in the whitelist group
fields.help_zh: 白名单组中的IP地址列表
fields.name: ips

fields.help_en: The type of the IP whitelist. The value is fixed as **PRIVATE_ES**, which indicates the private network access whitelist
fields.help_zh: IP白名单的类型。固定为**PRIVATE_ES**，即私网访问白名单
fields.name: white_ip_type

parameters.help_en:
Updates the instance whitelist configuration by whitelist group. Only one whitelist group can be updated at a time.
><notice> You cannot configure esIPWhitelist and whiteIpGroup at the same time.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
以白名单组方式更新实例白名单配置，仅支持更新一个白名单组。
><notice> 不支持同时配置esIPWhitelist和whiteIpGroup。
></notice>
parameters.name: white_ip_group
